scope: Independent review of score recount and paper-builder guards; no fresh forecasts scored, no final paper conversion or visual review performed.
checks: Synthetic historical-derived four-arm score dataset: 144 categorical, 24 continuous and 180 transition rows independently recounted.
Independently mutated categorical point count, hit count, duplicate flat index, and cross-hour latitude: each rejected without output receipt.
Builder rejects dangling output symlink and requires figure reference under --require-figures, without creating output.
Builder pre/post hashes markdown and embedded figures and checks DOCX media count.
limitations: Synthetic input is historical-derived and supplies no new forecast evidence.
Final manuscript must explicitly include and visually inspect both +1 and +6 figures; --require-figures requires at least one figure, not specifically both.
Verifier validates derived arrays and score arithmetic, not forecast provenance or execution.
